lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines observed across the primary torso bounding box; spacing is approximately equidistant with a slight increase in frequency towards the mid-posterior region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Line segments 4, 7, and 9 (counting from anterior to posterior) exhibit vertical abbreviations, failing to traverse the full distance to the ventral torso boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 5-6 high-contrast white spots is located on the posterior-lateral haunch, primarily concentrated in the lower-quadrant of the hindquarter.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A subset of three spots on the upper hind limb aligns in a diagonal geometric vector approximately parallel to the posterior muscle contour.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate curvature with a spiral twist; the vector originates at approximately 45 degrees from the skull base, sweeping laterally before orienting vertically and medially at the tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the terminal apical tips is approximately 2.8 times the pixel width measured at the horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping occupies approximately 18% of the total vertical pixel length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white erectile dorsal mane extending from the nape to the tail; distinct white facial chevron and white markings on the lower limbs above the hooves.
